يتبحبحا (form IIq)
# يَتَبَحْبَحَا (yatabaḥbaḥā) /ja.ta.baħ.ba.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# يُتَبَحْبَحَا (yutabaḥbaḥā) /ju.ta.baħ.ba.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
